title: GraphQL Error Handling — Structured Extension Codes Demo
title_es: Manejo de errores GraphQL — Demo de códigos de extensión estructurados
description: Runnable TypeScript demo of structured GraphQL errors: custom AppError classes with extensions.code, Apollo Server 4 formatError masking of INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, and real JSON responses for UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, and CONFLICT.
description_es: Demo TypeScript ejecutable de errores GraphQL estructurados: clases AppError con extensions.code, enmascarado de INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR en formatError de Apollo Server 4 y respuestas JSON reales para UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR y CONFLICT.
